name: Getac UX10-EX G5
summary: The Getac UX10-EX G5 is the hazardous-area version of a Getac rugged 10.1-inch tablet, certified for Zone 2/22 under IECEx. Getac also states ATEX certification, but the certificate isn't published. It is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) design running Windows 11 Pro.

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic op is IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex ic op is IIIC T130°C Dc
atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 2 (2026-09-03), checked 2026-10-25; ATEX not published; UKEX not found

iecex.marking: Ex ic op is IIC T4 Gc / Ex ic op is IIIC T130°C Dc

certification.protection: Intrinsic safety (Ex ic) with inherently safe optical radiation (op is)

safety.conditions: Protect from excessive UV light. Impact test at reduced height, protect from mechanical impact. Connection interfaces never used in hazardous areas. Battery never changed, charged or removed in hazardous areas. Not next to strong charge-generating processes. Use only battery BP3S2P2100S-01, BP3S3P3450P-03 or BP3S1P4070P-01. Ambient −21 to +55 °C.
safety.peripherals: All connection interfaces (USB, Thunderbolt, DC-in, docking connector, LAN, serial) must never be used in hazardous areas (certificate condition). Optional internal modules named in the certificate are covered as part of the certified tablet. Ports on the G5: two Thunderbolt 4, USB-A, DC-in, optional RJ45.
safety.certifiedAccessories: Named in the IECEx certificate: hand strap, 2-point shoulder strap, 4-point shoulder harness, capacitive stylus and tether, digitizer pen and tether. Anti-static screen protection film (Getac accessory made for hazardous use). Hard handle: not offered on the G5 datasheet. NOT for hazardous areas (accessory brochure): 65 W and 100 W AC adapters, DS100 docking station, high-capacity battery (replace in non-hazardous areas only), chargers.

os.name: Windows
os.updates: Windows 11: supported while kept on a current version (Microsoft Modern Lifecycle)

specs.display: 10.1-inch TFT LCD, LumiBond optically bonded, anti-static film
specs.chip: Intel Core Ultra 5 236V / Core Ultra 7 266V (series 2), Intel AI Boost NPU up to 48 TOPS
specs.ports: 2 x Thunderbolt 4 Type-C, USB 3.2 Gen2 Type-A, DC-in; optional RJ45; top slot: 1D/2D barcode or HF RFID; micro-SIM (optional); all barred from hazardous areas
specs.docking: Getac DS100 USB-C docking station (non-hazardous areas)
specs.gnss: Optional, with 4G/5G module (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BeiDou, QZSS)
specs.storage: 256 GB PCIe NVMe (options 512 GB, 1000 GB, 2000 GB)
specs.ruggedness: MIL-STD-810H; 1.8 m (6 ft) drop in use

capabilities.label: RFID
capabilities.value: Built in (optional HF RFID reader, top slot)

capabilities.label: NFC reading
capabilities.value: Built in (via optional HF RFID reader)

capabilities.label: Remote expert / video calls
capabilities.value: Via app (13 MP rear, 5 MP front)

capabilities.label: Windows desktop software
capabilities.value: Built in (Windows 11 Pro, x86; Copilot+ PC per press release)

unconfirmed.certification.iecex.number: Getac's certificate names the model with a 'c' suffix and doesn't name the generation. We matched it to this generation by its batteries, dust group and ambient range.
unconfirmed.os.edition: The maker doesn't state the edition year.

limitations: Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
